items.claim: Gillian Robertson is a fighter who inflicts damage and aggressively pursues finishes.
items.quote: she's [ __ ] nasty, inflicts damage, will go for wins, uh go for or go for finishes.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson needs to secure a takedown and end up on top to deal damage to Mackenzie Dern.
items.quote: she literally in this fight is going to have to have a takedown to where she's on top and being able to put damage on Mackenzie Dern

items.claim: Gillian Robertson holds the advantage over Mackenzie Dern in the striking department.
items.quote: On the feet, I leaned Robertson.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has historically struggled with consistently securing takedowns.
items.quote: Mackenzie Dern is she's never been great at like getting her takedowns. She's had a lot of problems with getting takedowns consistently

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has taken significant damage and been busted up in fights due to the time it takes her to secure takedowns.
items.quote: will take a beating. Like she's been busted up in quite a few fights because it takes her so much time to finally get that takedown.

items.claim: If Gillian Robertson ends up underneath Mackenzie Dern on the ground, she will lose the position.
items.quote: If she's underneath Mackenzie Dern like she's losing.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson's last three opponents have a combined record of two and thirteen.
items.quote: Her last three wins the ladies that she beat are a combined two and 13.
